statement: BA2037 is the earliest publicly sold Nike SB RPM: the archive's 'Year Zero'.
construction_criterion: Fixed feature map as stated in essay 01: board-carry straps, padded laptop sleeve, MOLLE webbing.
notes: The archive's working position, stated in essay 01 and docs/Methodology.md. 'First' means earliest documented so far. RPM-UNIT-001 (in hand, label 06/2007, factory ESM) witnesses that BA2037-089 was produced by June 2007. It does not establish that BA2037 was the first RPM sold: that needs dated release evidence and an argument that no earlier retail RPM exists.

statement: Elephant/cement-print SB backpacks shown in 2006 media previews are pre-production (incubation), not the retail RPM.
notes: Stated in essay 01. A preview is a first_documented event, not a production or release date. RPM-SOURCE-003 (Hypebeast, 2006-08-24) refers to a cement-pattern backpack posted earlier in 2006; that earlier post, which would show the bag, is not located. No unit to cite, so still speculative.

statement: BA2037-089 (black) and BA2037-222 (tan) were released together, late 2007 to early 2008.
notes: Stated in essay 01. For the black: listed in Nike SB's Holiday 2007 dealer catalogue (RPM-SOURCE-001, image dated July 2007 [infer]); produced by June 2007 (RPM-UNIT-001, label 06/2007); a black SB backpack with the modular attachments at retail by 3 April 2008 (RPM-SOURCE-002, no code named). Consistent with the claim's window, but no source yet ties a retail date to the code. For the tan: the catalogue names the colourway Loden with a suffix read as 3?0; this claim and the pre-corpus register say 222; the owner's July 2025 write-up says 223. Unresolved until the tan label is logged and the catalogue reading confirmed. A release date only, not a production date.

statement: The RPM sequence runs BA2037, then BA2318-089, then BA2449-089: proof of concept, material experiment, refinement.
construction_criterion: BA2318: synthetic-leather elephant panels. BA2449: wider print coverage and upgraded hardware (per essay 01).
notes: Stated in essay 01. Rests on code order alone; no label dates are logged on either side.

statement: The pre-corpus register's BA2049-089 is an entry error for BA2449-089.
notes: Retracted 2026-10-01 on the owner's correction: BA2049-089 and BA2449-089 are different bags, not one code mistyped. The hypothesis leaned on its documentary-footprint axis (BA2449-089 indexed online as a 'vintage cement elephant' backpack, BA2049-089 nowhere), which carried a BA2449 match over to BA2049. A label photograph of a BA2049-089 unit is the witness that settles the code.

statement: Style code BA3241 (suffixes -001, -010, -200, -210, -601) belongs to the Nike SB RPM line.
notes: Published on this site before 1 October 2026 with details (for example 'James Arizumi', 'Archive Records #601') that had no source. No Nike product was found under BA3241 (search of retail and resale listings, 2026-10-01). Withdrawn 2026-10-01.

statement: BA5404-010 is a 2016 'Floral Camo' RPM from a seasonal Floral collection.
notes: Published on this site before 1 October 2026 with no source. The style code exists (listings describe an RPM all-over-print in black); the description does not. Withdrawn 2026-10-01.

statement: RPM body material shifts from heavy polyester duck canvas to lighter recycled synthetics.
notes: From essay 02 (Jan 2026), withdrawn from the site 2026-10-01. No units cited and no date or code given for the shift. The essay's further reading, that the shift marks a change in Nike SB's environmental policy, is not carried over: it is an inference about the manufacturer with no source.
